There is some ambiguity in terms of how best to translate this prayer. The author asks that his relatives are ‘ausgelest’, which would normally read as a form of the verb ‘auslesen’, meaning to select or pick out. However, in this section of the letter the author repeatedly spells words that normally contain the vowel ‘ö’ with an ‘e’ instead (e.g. ‘Angeherigen’ for ‘Angehörigen’, ‘meglichkeiten’ for ‘Möglichkeiten’), so it seems quite likely that ‘ausgelest’ is an alternative spelling of ‘ausgelöst’, which can mean freed, released or gotten out of something/somewhere, especially in Austrian German.
